cachedNativePlayback.initialNativeObservation: User reported red/green Loading indicators; character itself appeared normally. Original single-frame refresh remains confirmed; initial continuous-display trial did not meet quality acceptance.

nativeSequencePreview.oneTimeSetup: Open MCP-sequence.spine, switch to ANIMATE, expand Animations and activate MCP-playback using its visibility dot at the far left of the tree row. Enable loop and play once.
